name: production-ecs-platform
description: Original ECS Fargate application platform with Terraform and Jenkins delivery.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix apps/api && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
